description: This file defines the IBasketViewModelService interface, which declares methods for retrieving or creating a basket for a user, counting total items, and mapping basket entities to view models within the eShopOnWeb web application.

classes.name: IBasketViewModelService
classes.description: Interface for basket view model services, providing methods to manage user baskets and map basket entities to view models.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Retrieves an existing basket for the specified user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Counts the total number of items in the specified user's basket.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket entity to a BasketViewModel.
